# Reporting issues to MavisX

Thanks for helping test **MavisX** — the all-in-one desktop toolkit for IT and homelab work (monitoring, SSH/SFTP, Docker, network tools, and a credential vault, in one window).

You don't need to be a developer to be useful here. The best thing you can do is **file clear, reproducible reports**. This guide shows how.

## Found a bug?

Open a [Bug report](https://github.com/LTSneaX/MavisX/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). The form asks for:

- **What happened** and **steps to reproduce** — the single most important part. If we can reproduce it, we can fix it.
- **Expected vs actual** behavior.
- **Which feature** (monitors, SSH, SFTP, Docker, vault, alerts, network, other).
- **MavisX version** (installer filename or the About screen, e.g. `0.3.0`) and your **Windows version**.
- **Logs or screenshots** if you have them.

> Please **redact secrets** — passwords, SSH keys, API tokens, hostnames you don't want public — before pasting logs or screenshots.

## Have an idea?

Open a [Feature request](https://github.com/LTSneaX/MavisX/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Tell us the *problem* you're trying to solve, not just the solution — it helps us find the best fix.

## Just a question?

Use [Discussions](https://github.com/LTSneaX/MavisX/discussions) or the [website](https://mavisx.ortzabari.co.il) — not the issue tracker.

## A few tips for great reports

- **One issue per report.** Two bugs? Two reports.
- **Search first** — someone may have already filed it. A 👍 on an existing issue helps us prioritize.
- **Screenshots and short screen recordings** are gold.
- **Tell us how consistently it happens** — every time, or just sometimes?

That's it. Thank you for making MavisX better.
